title: Team-level invite guardrails with reputation-based throttles and audit hooks
creator: Marisol Vega
description: Add per-team invite guardrails that apply reputation-based throttles, domain attestation fallbacks, and atomic audit-log hooks. This ticket implements a policy layer that evaluates an inbound invite request (email/domain) against: 1) reputation score (MX/SPF/DMARC, known provider lists, bounce history), 2) team-level allowlist/denylist, and 3) SSO enforcement settings. Decision will surface enforcement action (allow, require attestation, queue-for-review, block) and emit a structured audit event that includes the policy evaluation vector. This integrates with RBAC v2 so admin role assertions (team-admin vs org-admin) can bypass or escalate policy outcomes as configured.
acceptance_criteria: Policy engine evaluates invite requests and returns one of {allow, require_attestation, review_queue, block}
Reputation score computed from MX/SPF/DMARC checks, provider reputation table, and historical bounce rate; documented scoring thresholds
Team-level UI settings exist for: invite mode (open/invite-only), email allowlist, email denylist, per-team throttle multiplier
Audit log entries created for every invite request with policy decision, actor, evaluated signals, and resulting action
RBAC v2 honors override rules: org-admin can set 'force-allow' and team-admin can set 'moderate' behavior; overrides are logged
SAML customers with SSO enforcement have invites auto-flagged for review if email domain != verified SSO domain
End-to-end tests for invite flow across combinations: blocked provider, unverified domain, allowlist match, org-admin override
Docs and runbook updated: Confluence page, API changelog, and console tooltip copy for team settings
tasks: Design policy schema for invite evaluations and store in config service
Implement reputation scoring microservice and provider reputation table
Expose team-level settings in Console and API (allowlist/denylist/throttle)
Wire policy evaluation into invite API path and ensure latency < 120ms p95
Emit structured audit events (JSON) to audit pipeline with new 'invite_policy_evaluation' type
Add RBAC v2 checks for admin overrides and tie to policy engine
Create unit/integration tests and add e2e harness against staging SSO tenant
Update docs, runbook, and create a migration plan for existing teams
